title: Cyber Eye
summary: Live camera as Matrix rain, ASCII, GameBoy, pseudo-thermal & night vision
description: Turns the CardputerZero 8 MP camera into a real-time cyberpunk viewfinder. Styles: Matrix code rain built from live luminance, classic ASCII, GameBoy Camera 4-shade dither, 1-bit dither, Predator-style pseudo-thermal (brightness mapped to a heat palette, not a real thermal sensor) with HUD telemetry, night-vision green and neon edges. Freeze frame, contrast control and animated GIF recording. Keyboard only, English and Ukrainian.

uk.summary: Камера наживо: дощ Matrix, ASCII, GameBoy, псевдо-тепловізор, нічне бачення
